workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison. I've checked Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the times that are free for Priya and Marcus work for Elena and David. All of those potential slots are booked in their calendars. We'll need to find another solution. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
OK, thanks for checking, Brad. Let's try being more specific. I've found all the 30-minute slots when both Priya and Marcus are free. Can you please check these specific times against Elena's and David's calendars?

Mon 09:00-09:30
Mon 09:30-10:00
Tue 13:00-13:30
Tue 13:30-14:00
Tue 16:30-17:00
Wed 15:00-15:30
Wed 15:30-16:00
Thu 10:00-10:30
Fri 11:00-11:30
Fri 11:30-12:00

Let me know if any of these work.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I've checked the list of times you provided against Elena's and David's calendars. Unfortunately, none of those slots are free. For every time you suggested, either Elena, David, or both are busy.

I did a full search of all calendars for the entire week, and it appears there are no 30-minute slots where all four partners are free.

Given this, we won't find a time without a conflict. Perhaps our best option is to find a slot that conflicts for only one partner and ask them to reschedule? I can search for times that work for Priya, Marcus, and David (but not Elena), and times that work for Priya, Marcus, and Elena (but not David). Let me know what you think.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, just following up on my previous message. Have you had a chance to consider my proposal to find a time that works for three of the four partners? Let me know what you think.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I did respond earlier, but it seems you may not have received my message. I apologize for any confusion.

Yes, I agree with your plan. Please go ahead and search for times that work for:
1. Priya, Marcus, and David (conflicting with Elena)
2. Priya, Marcus, and Elena (conflicting with David)

Let me know what you find. Thanks!

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Great, thanks, Alison. I've found a couple of options.

The best one seems to be **Wednesday at 15:00**. This time works for Priya, Marcus, and Elena, but conflicts with a 'Partner lunch' in David's calendar. This seems like it might be flexible.

Alternatively, Thursday at 10:00 works for everyone except Elena, who has a 'Hiring panel'.

I suggest we proceed with Wednesday at 15:00. If you agree, please book it and let me know. I'll then send the confirmation email to everyone and mention that David will need to adjust his schedule.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Thanks, Brad. I agree that Wednesday at 15:00 is the best option. I've gone ahead and created the booking in the system.

Please send the confirmation email to all the partners, and let David know he'll need to reschedule his lunch.

Thanks for your help with this!

emails.body:
This email confirms the booking of the partner meeting for next week.

Please note, David, we understand this conflicts with a 'Partner lunch' in your calendar and would be grateful if you could reschedule it. We appreciate your flexibility.
